# Feed Thumbnail

Feed Thumbnail is a public browser toolkit for checking, downloading, making, and reading YouTube thumbnail and channel-banner references.

## Useful pages

- [Thumbnail Tester](https://feedthumbnail.com/): preview a local thumbnail in simulated YouTube layouts.
- [YouTube thumbnail size](https://feedthumbnail.com/youtube-thumbnail-size): source-linked thumbnail dimensions and format notes.
- [YouTube banner size](https://feedthumbnail.com/youtube-banner-size): source-linked banner canvas and safe-area notes.
- [Public lookup API](https://feedthumbnail.com/ai/): bounded machine-readable reference lookup.

## Agent discovery

- [Service index](https://feedthumbnail.com/ai/index.ilang)
- [Site lookup skill](https://feedthumbnail.com/ai/skills/site-lookup/SKILL.md)
- [API catalog](https://feedthumbnail.com/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [MCP server card](https://feedthumbnail.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [ARD manifest](https://feedthumbnail.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)

## Limits

The public lookup is read-only and supports only the two named topics. It does not fetch arbitrary URLs, access private data, create accounts, or perform writes.
